HelpTip.Endpoint.Label: Catalog address
HelpTip.Endpoint.Content: The endpoint identifies the server that provides mod and release metadata. Change it only to a trusted HTTPS address; catalog sync does not download or install game files.
HelpTip.Secrets.Label: Secret store
HelpTip.Secrets.Content: Passwords and tokens use the system secret store. The fallback file store requires separate consent and a password that remains in the current session.
Ui.Library.DuplicatesTitle: The same game in several places
Ui.Library.DuplicatesHint: When the same game sits in two libraries, the launcher may start a different copy than the one with your mods. Below are paths only — nothing is deleted.
Duplicates.None: No duplicate games in Steam libraries.
Duplicates.Explanation: Remove the extra copies yourself in the Steam folder. The one Steam updated last is usually the one the launcher starts.
